correctness.rationale: For p_T(r)=F_T(r)−F_T(r−1), the exact mass on the stated inclusive integer support a≤r≤b is F_T(b)−F_T(a−1), whereas the denominator printed in the 2026 source Eq.(3.2) is F_T(b)−F_T(a). Therefore the printed product sum is ∏_i [1+p_T(a_i)/(F_T(b_i)−F_T(a_i))]>1, with strictly positive Brownian-range cell probabilities. The correct conditional product and corresponding CDF subtract F_T(a_i−1). Independent high-precision evaluation of the source series at T=1 and its actual market support [2,8]×[1,7] gives total published mass 86.7321789530702265665 and lower-left alleged atom 65.7651669084577193031, both impossible for a PMF. Brownian scaling and a reflection-principle upper bound on P(R_T≥1) also prove the [0,1] printed zero-cell mass tends to infinity at least as (1/4)exp(1/(8T))−1. The proof of nonnormalization is telescoping; numerical series corroborate the source-specific magnitude.
